title: The Great Rift Arrives November 3rd
excerpt: Brian's next novel, The Great Rift, the sequel to The Last Voyage, releases November 3rd. While you wait, here are a few conversations from The Last Voyage tour worth revisiting…
body:
[![Cover of The Great Rift](/the-great-rift.jpg)](https://bookshop.org/p/books/the-great-rift-brian-d-mclaren/21462f123b507d46)

Brian's next novel, The Great Rift, the sequel to The Last Voyage, releases November 3rd.

While you wait, here are a few conversations from The Last Voyage tour worth revisiting:

• [Nomad Podcast: Spirituality at the End of the World](https://www.nomadpodcast.co.uk/brian-mclaren-spirituality-at-the-end-of-the-world-n350/)
• [CBF Podcast: Brian McLaren on The Last Voyage](https://cbf.net/cbf-podcast-brian-mclaren-the-last-voyage/)
• [Shifting Culture: Episode 322 with Brian McLaren](https://www.shiftingculturepodcast.com/episodes/episode-322-brianmclaren)
• [Faith Matters: The Last Voyage](https://www.faithmatters.org/p/brian-mclaren-the-last-voyage)
• [This Is Not Church: A Conversation With Brian McLaren](https://www.patheos.com/editorial/podcasts/this-is-not-church-podcast/2025/the-last-voyage-a-conversation-with-brian-mclaren)
• [G(od)-Spot Podcast: The Last Voyage](https://monica6.podbean.com/e/s9-episode-10-the-last-voyage-brian-mclaren/)

The Great Rift is [available for pre-order now](https://bookshop.org/p/books/the-great-rift-brian-d-mclaren/21462f123b507d46).
